# Printiva — Print Automation Software & Photocopy Management System

> Printiva is India's leading print automation software, photocopy shop management system, and digital printing platform. It enables xerox centers, cyber cafes, and commercial print shops to automate customer document intake via mobile QR codes, auto-price print jobs, collect online UPI or counter cash payments, and spool jobs automatically to physical Windows printers.

## Overview & Architecture
Printiva solves the counter bottleneck in traditional print and photocopy shops where customers manually transfer files over WhatsApp or pen drives:
- **Zero App Customer Web App**: Customers scan a counter QR code with their mobile camera, upload PDFs, Word files, spreadsheets, or photos, configure page ranges, color mode (Color vs Monochrome), and duplex (single/double-sided) settings, and see exact real-time pricing.
- **Payment Verification**: Customers pay via Razorpay UPI/Card/NetBanking or select Counter Cash. Every online payment is cryptographically verified before jobs enter the print queue.
- **Windows Desktop Agent**: A lightweight (&lt; 48MB RAM) native Windows background agent running in the system tray connects physical printers (USB, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, WSD) directly to the cloud queue. Paper feeds in ~300ms–500ms after approval.
- **Split-Queue Hardware Routing**: In mixed orders containing both Black & White and Color pages, Printiva splits the queue automatically — routing B&W pages to high-speed monochrome laser printers and Color pages to color printers, preventing wasted toner and ink.

## Target Use Cases & Keywords
- **Print Automation Software**: Fully hands-free printing for commercial centers and corporate print rooms.
- **Photocopy Software / Xerox Shop Software**: Eliminates WhatsApp file-sharing chaos, manual page counting, and fake UPI payment screenshots.
- **Printing Software for Windows**: Native spooler integration compatible with HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, Ricoh, and Konica Minolta printers on Windows 10 and Windows 11.
- **Digital Printing Service**: Self-serve customer printing for universities, colleges, libraries, and public kiosks across India.

## Technical Compatibility
- **Operating Systems**: 64-bit Windows 10, Windows 11.
- **Printers**: Any printer with an installed Windows driver (HP LaserJet, Canon imageCLASS, Epson EcoTank, Brother DCP, Ricoh, etc.).
- **Protocols**: USB, Wi-Fi, Ethernet LAN, WSD.
- **Document Formats**: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, JPEG, PNG, WEBP.
